Commissioning: Commissioning is a process that involves the entire Design Team throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers. ip_data_security.text: nboarding the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) to the National Eye Institute’s (NEI) existing OpenSpecimen biobanking software instance and implementing associated Electronic Medical Record (EMR) integration services. Competition is restricted to Krishagni LLC because NHLBI’s requirement is specifically to onboard to NEI’s active, Krishagni-licensed and operated OpenSpecimen environment rather than to procure a separate standalone biobanking system. Acquiring a different biobanking product would not satisfy the requirement to join the existing NEI shared instance and would result in substantial duplication of software licensing, implementation, validation, and support infrastructure costs, as well as unacceptable operational delays. As the software developer, proprietor, and operator of the existing NEI OpenSpecimen environment, Krishagni LLC is the only responsible source authorized and technically capable of performing the required onboarding, workflow configuration, and EMR integration services within that shared platform. Requirements/Salient Characteristics: The following specification lists the minimum requirements for a lock-in amplifier. Objective requirements are also highlighted when available. A lock-in amplifier is crucial for separating laser photodetector outputs from noise that may otherwise drown out the signal. Therefore, this lock-in component is necessary for meeting mission requirements. 3.1. The lock-in amplifier shall meet the following technical requirements: 3.1.1. Demodulation capability for DC up to 600 megahertz or higher reference signals 3.1.2. At least two analog BNC inputs 3.1.3. At least two analog BNC outputs 3.1.4. Analog to digital input conversion capability included, along with the inverse of digital to analog output conversion 3.1.5. Minimum sampling rate for input data of 1.25 giga-samples per second (GSa/s) 3.1.6. USB 2.0 or USB-C interface is supported 3.1.7. PC software interface included 3.1.8. Coding support for either Python or MATLAB languages 3.1.8.1. API for supported language must be given 3.1.9. Come with a manufacturer’s warranty of at least 1 year 3.1.10.
